treat-200-as-placed.description: Any 200 counts as a placed order, so a p-ticket, p-captcha or rejection body is recorded as ACKED.
expectedFailures: (g) penalty in a 200 body
(h) p-captcha
(n) follower rejection
(q) the engine under the same seed
(t) dashboard JSON

intent-after-send.description: SENDING is committed after the network call instead of before it, so a crash in between leaves PLANNED and the restart re-sends.
expectedFailures: (f) process killed at after_send_before_ack
(f) process killed at after_ack_before_commit

no-grace-window.description: One empty lookup is enough to re-send: no grace window for an order that is slow to appear.
expectedFailures: (c) response lost after accept, order visible only inside the grace window
(d) response lost before accept
(p) a reduction on a pair with an unresolved order
(q) the engine under the same seed

ignore-captcha.description: p-captcha is read as an ordinary penalty: the login waits p-time and tries again, instead of stopping.
expectedFailures: (h) p-captcha

feed-no-dedupe.description: A repeated fill is ingested again. The unique intent key still stops a second order, but the master position is counted twice, so the expected positions are wrong.
expectedFailures: (b) duplicate and out-of-order master frames
(m) master feed stall and reconnect
